glosses: stretcher (simple litter designed to carry a sick, injured or dead person)

examples.text: Eles levaram o jogador machucado embora numa maca.
examples.en: They carried the injured player away on a stretcher.

examples.text: Tom acordou amarrado a uma maca.
examples.en: Tom woke up strapped to a gurney.
They brought Tom in on a stretcher.
